objectives.description: Read final state of all four files, check three accounts agree
Confirm zero behavioral drift via git diff

approaches_tried.approach: Attempted to diff against a pre-task commit via `git stash` + `git checkout <old-sha> -- .` to double-check whether validate-wiring.sh's neovim/memory failures were pre-existing
approaches_tried.reason: The stash swept in concurrent sibling tasks' (139, 162, 163, 199, 207, 244) uncommitted in-flight work in this shared working tree -- exactly the hazard the dispatch's concurrency_note warns about. Immediately ran `git stash pop` to restore it (confirmed via git status, no data lost) and did not repeat the checkout. Resolved instead by reasoning from `git diff --stat` over this task's own commit range, which already proves none of the four email paths this task touched overlap with the failing neovim/memory paths.

deviations.reason: The script fails with 11 pre-existing errors, all missing project/neovim/** and project/memory/README.md context files -- entirely unrelated to and outside agent-system/extensions/email/**, and not touched by any commit in this task's range or by any concurrent sibling's declared file_scope this cycle.
